property_summary: For any call to forward, if the underlying call fails, the reference correctly reverts the outer call (reverting the transaction), while the mutant silently ignores the failure and returns successfully, which can be observed by checking whether a subsequent call executes after a failing forward.
change_summary: Remove the require statement, so the call failure is ignored and the function always returns successfully.
mutated_unit_code: function forward(address callee, bytes memory _data) public { (bool _s,) = callee.call(_data); }
